note: Albania: US citizens enter without a visa for a year; nationals of the long list for 90 days in any 180 (some temporary, 15 April to 31 December 2026), Kazakhstan 90 in a year. Everyone else needs a visa (holders of used Schengen or US multiple-entry visas, or Schengen, UK or US residence, may enter visa-free: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
